results.title: Refining constraints could keep fuel prices high: CIO - CNBC
results.snippet: Refining constraints could keep fuel prices high: CIO. Michael Alfaro, Gallo Partners' CIO, says that U.S. refiners are near capacity and are in wait-and-see mode for potential product export bans. He's worried that a refining downtime during a prolonged conflict could further push up gasoline and other product prices.
